edits.old: No personal data in logs, tests, workflow inputs, history or prompts.
edits.new: No direct identifier or customer value in logs, tests, workflow inputs, history or prompts. Data Classification v5 classes `account_key` as a Confidential indirect identifier: it is shown within the role's scope, masked in UAT and carried as a reference only, the clear key is read by REST under the masking policy, and a log holds the id of the read, never the clear key. It classes `booked_at` as Confidential customer data: a business fact only, never beside a direct identifier, and a log holds a code or an id only. The `idempotency_key` of the platform library tables is classed as not personal data.
